faq.question: Can I record a video podcast at Birdcast?
faq.answer: Yes. Birdcast supports podcast recording with cameras, lighting, microphones and a professional studio environment.

faq.question: Is the studio beginner-friendly?
faq.answer: Yes. The team can guide you through the setup, pacing, recording flow and delivery process.

faq.question: Can I bring guests?
faq.answer: Yes. Birdcast can support different podcast and interview formats depending on the number of guests and selected studio setup.

faq.question: Can a podcast session also create clips?
faq.answer: Yes. If planned before the session, podcast recordings can often be repurposed into short clips for social platforms.

faq.question: Which Dubai locations are available?
faq.answer: Birdcast has a professional studio located in Dubai Investment Park.
